title: The New Apple Watch Series 12 Is Almost Here, and It Might Not Come Alone
summary: According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing both an Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 for this fall, with faster chips and new health and fitness features, but no major design overhaul.
